Florges

Fairy

Kalos · Generation 6

Florges is a Fairy-type Garden Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 10 kg. It evolves from Floette. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (154), with a base stat total of 552.
